narrative_purpose: The dim full-bleed atmospheric backdrop the chapter's text floats over: a vast night-forest expanse that evokes a whole wilderness full of unseen hunters and hunted, dissolving into haze so overlaid long-form text stays readable.
subject: A vast nocturnal forested valley seen from a very high vantage, ridge after ridge of canopy fading into deep haze, scattered faint constellations of bioluminescent glow across the dark expanse, with a few barely-perceptible pairs of predator-eye glints low among the trees, nothing sharp or focal.
scene: Pandoran rainforest at night under a faintly luminous sky, layered atmospheric depth, drifting spore-fog softening every distance.
camera: Ultra-wide panoramic high-altitude vista, looking out and slightly down across endless canopy.
light: No bright focal source; only diffuse low bioluminescence scattered through the dark and a dim sky-glow, everything low-contrast and shadowed.
palette: Deep void-indigo and teal-indigo throughout, only the faintest cyan and living-teal glow points, no warm accent, kept dark and muted.
style: Hand-painted atmospheric vista, soft and tonal, detail dissolving into haze, a mood layer not a figure to study.
detail_level: Low and soft everywhere; no crisp focal subject; built for text to sit on top.
composition: Wide horizon of receding ridges, generous dark sky and haze, deliberately empty of any single subject.
consistency_notes: Pure background mood layer; must stay dark and low-contrast so overlaid chapter text remains legible. Not an inline figure.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no UI chrome, no bright focal point, no high contrast, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares
